name: dsh-plugin-boot-whale-maid
description: DeepSeek Harness boot stage: a full-screen whale-maid curtain-up for the splash, then a fade to the real UI. Host half injects a synchronous first frame that covers DSH's native [data-dsh-boot] card before the shell paints it; the Web client half mounts the stage in a shadow root.
//files-note: docs/ ships because scripts/smoke.mjs and scripts/assert.mjs both read docs/assets.json, so the package must be able to verify itself after unpacking. The review screenshots under docs/shots/ are excluded by .npmignore (see that file) because they document the build for the repository rather than serving the installed plugin. Nothing from the source skin package is ever bundled.
